findings.description: The match check changed from self.match.match(...) to self.match.fullmatch(...), so a pattern now has to match the entire exception message instead of a prefix.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout") with an exception whose message is "timeout after 5s". Under the old re.match semantics this matched and the retry happened. With fullmatch it returns False, so the exception is no longer retried. Impact: existing users with prefix-style patterns silently stop retrying, which changes retry behavior without any API change.
